paragraphs: বাংলা বই খুঁজে নেওয়া, পড়া, পর্যালোচনা লেখা আর হাতে হাতে বই বিনিময়ের একটি ওয়েবসাইট।

Boi Mohol is a Bangla-first web app for readers in Bangladesh. You can find books by category, with a "start here" pick in each one, keep a shelf, and write reviews. Public-domain classics can be read for free, and physical books can be passed on through a small marketplace with built-in chat. Every screen is in Bangla, with Bangla digits and dates in Bangladesh time. Underneath are the details a Bangla product actually needs:
features: search treats differently encoded Bangla text as the same word;
the library refuses any PDF or reading link that the copyright rule doesn't clear;
moderation and the privacy policy describe what the code really does.
A catalog organised by category. Each category has an editorial "শুরু করুন এখান থেকে" (start here) pick.
Book pages with an overall rating plus optional aspect ratings (plot, writing, pacing). Reviews can be edited or deleted by their authors.

requirements.text: Existing email/password accounts still log in, and any account can set a password in settings.
On every request it re-reads the account to check that it still exists, isn't suspended, has finished sign-up and was issued for the current password.
